alt: Four square samples show wood grain, woven cloth, clear glass with a leaf visible beneath it, and gray metal.
A fingertip makes a dent in a blue cushion at left. At right, a fingertip presses a wooden block whose top stays flat.
A fingertip presses against the top of a red brick. The fingertip flattens slightly while the brick keeps its shape.
A finger presses deeply into a teal cushion, making a dent surrounded by fabric folds.
Two hands hold the ends of a thin blue strip curved into an arch, with no visible break.
Coarse tan cloth has thick crossing threads, uneven raised fibers, and open gaps in its weave.
A clear rectangular glass tile rests on a pale table, with an even flat surface and a bright reflected highlight.
A rounded clear water bead sits on top of a red fabric square, with no spreading wet patch visible.
A red woven square has a darker damp patch spreading among its threads, without a standing water bead.
Three trays hold white paper, a fluffy blue sample, and a green sheet. A measuring spoon and cup of water sit nearby.
At left, a hand rests against a window with a tree visible outside. At right, a finger makes a dent in a folded purple sweater.
A clear rounded bead sits on the left red square. The right red towel square has a dark damp patch among its loops.
Water drips through a tear in a damp paper canopy onto a toy bear sitting in a tray below.
Three trays hold white, blue, and green sample squares. A measuring spoon, water cup, and hourglass stand in front.
White and blue samples have dark damp patches in separate trays. A green sheet in a third tray has a clear puddle on its surface.
A kitchen contains a window showing a tree, a wooden chair, a metal pot, a white towel, and a blue bowl.
Hands curve a blue strip into an arch at left. At right, another pair of hands pulls an orange rubber band into a long narrow loop.
Two ceramic cups sit on a tray. The left cup is intact; the right has a chipped rim, with a detached piece beside it.
Two tan rectangular samples sit side by side: raised woven fibers at left and an even wooden surface with grain at right.
Three upright panels sit in a wooden holder. A red ball is clear through the left panel, blurred through the middle, and not visible through the wooden right panel.
Three similarly sized square samples lie in a row: white textured paper, fluffy blue fibers, and a shiny green sheet. A square white template sits above.
Three separate trays each hold a blue square with no visible wet patch. A measuring spoon and water cup sit in front.
A child draws a green square with a blue bead on paper. Beside the drawing, a green sample in a tray holds a clear water bead.
A clear jar holds colored pencils at left. At right, a hand presses a folded cloth into a small spill on a wooden table.
